_notes: E2 — California daily overtime. One crew day (06:00 time-in, 17:30 time-out) is one job card.
The engine deducts one automatic half-hour meal (11.50 gross -> 11.00 net), then splits the NET
day into three buckets: 8 regular, 2 at 1.5x, 1 at 2x, carried in three separate columns.
Every derivation keys on net hours, never gross. The thresholds live in the legacy rule editor
(catalog A10) and are proven by consequence — the 8/2/1 split and the 260.00 amount.
